entities.name: IL8-like chemokine
observations: 101-aa secreted protein sequence with an N-terminal signal peptide-like hydrophobic segment (residues 1–~22).
Contains a Pfam IL8 domain (PF00048.26) at residues 33–91; domain i-Evalue 3.3e-17.
Shows 86.1–88.1% full-length identity to reviewed ovine, canine, and bovine interleukin-8 proteins, with E-values 1.7e-57 to 3.0e-58.
Predicted molecular weight is 11.43 kDa and theoretical pI is 8.65; these are sequence-derived estimates for the unprocessed protein.

Likely secreted extracellular chemokine that binds CXCR-family GPCRs, promotes neutrophil chemotaxis and activation, and participates in inflammatory and host-defense responses; exact species and receptor pharmacology are inferred from homologs.

entities.name: Interleukin-8
observations: Reviewed mammalian IL-8 homologs are secreted chemokines with extracellular localization and CXCR1/CXCR2 receptor-binding activity.
Annotated processes include inflammatory response, neutrophil chemotaxis, neutrophil activation, defense response, immune response, and cellular responses to IL-1, lipopolysaccharide, and TNF.
IL-8 homologs can form homodimers and bind heparin/glycosaminoglycan-related extracellular components.

entities.name: Neutrophil chemotaxis
observations: IL-8/CXCL8-like chemokines attract neutrophils through CXCR-family chemokine receptors.

entities.name: Inflammatory response
observations: Close IL-8 homologs participate in inflammatory and host-defense responses, including responses to IL-1, bacterial lipopolysaccharide, and TNF.
